title: Jagged Fresh Ethiopian Lentils Fir Fir
description: A fresh and adventurous Ethiopian dish featuring doenjang and namul-blanch-season, made with satvik-friendly ingredients, this jagged fir fir is a unique twist on traditional Ethiopian cuisine. It is a hearty and flavorful meal that is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large pot, combine the lentils and water and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the doenjang, namul, onion, garlic, ginger, berbere spice, and salt.
Add the doenjang mixture to the pot with the lentils and stir to combine.
Continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and serve the fir fir hot.
Traditionally, fir fir is served with a side of injera bread, but it can also be served with rice or noodles.
To make the dish more substantial, add some sauteed vegetables, such as spinach or carrots, to the pot with the lentils.
Experiment with different spices and seasonings to give the fir fir your own unique flavor.
